text: .34 Severe infec- tions require oral treatment with an azole.35 Griseofulvin is not effective. Other infections in which Malassezia yeasts are implicated include seborrhoeic dermatitis (p.1584) and pityrosporum folliculitis, both of which may present in a more severe form in patients with AIDS.
